claims.claim: Ticketdesk AI offers AI agents that automatically handle customer support tickets across chat and email, learning from documentation and routing complex issues to humans.

excerpts.excerpt: Transform your customer support with AI agents that handle tickets automatically, learn from your documentation, and route complex issues to the right team members - available on chat and email.

claims.caveat: Same company voice repeated across its own pages, not independently verified.
claims.claim: The company claims its AI can resolve up to 70% of tickets without human handoff.

excerpts.excerpt: Resolve up to 70% of tickets without human handoff
Resolve up to 70% of tickets without human handoff

claims.claim: Product features include canned responses, human-in-loop handoff, white-label email, multiple inboxes, tagging/priority, search/filter, API access, reporting, multiple AI models, and an embeddable chat widget.

excerpts.excerpt: Canned Responses Create and manage pre-written responses with dynamic variables
Embeddable Chat Add a chat widget to your website with one line of code

claims.caveat: Comparison is self-reported and described as for 'informational purposes only' with prices as of 2026, which is an unusual/future date for a pricing snapshot.
claims.claim: The company positions itself as far cheaper than competing customer support platforms, claiming to be '10x cheaper than the alternatives.'

Pricing tiers range from $29/month to $249/month with varying numbers of AI agents, credits, automation rules, team members and training sources, plus a custom 'Contact us' enterprise tier; all plans include a 14-day free trial.

excerpts.excerpt: $29 /month 1 AI agent 5,000 AI credits 5 automation rules 3 team members 250 training sources
All plans include a 14-day free trial.

claims.caveat: Unverified marketing claim with no named customers or data.
